column1: # Behavior case table shared by tools/test-hooks.sh (runs hooks/*.sh) and tools/test-hooks.ps1
# (runs hooks/*.ps1). One row per case, five required TAB-separated fields plus an optional sixth:
# hook is the script base name, [a-z0-9-] only; each harness appends its own extension.
# verdict is one of deny|allow|warn|silent|rewrite. signature is the substring the deny reason
# (deny rows), stderr (warn rows), or decoded hookSpecificOutput.updatedToolOutput stdout/stderr
# (rewrite rows) must contain, matched as a literal string; '-' means no signature and is required
# on allow/silent rows, forbidden on deny/warn/rewrite rows. The sixth field becomes the payload's
# tool_response; rewrite rows require it, and a trailing empty one is an error.
# ASCII only, LF endings (pinned in .gitattributes), no TAB inside a field; non-ASCII content rides
# Placeholders each harness substitutes before dispatch, in forward-slash form: @WF_FIXDIR@ (that
# run's warn-file-size fixture directory), @REPO_ROOT@ (the checkout root), @CTO_FILLER@ (100
# JSON-escaped filler lines that clear compact-test-output's MIN_CHARS floor), and @LONG_LINE@
# Both harnesses verify the declared count below against the rows they parse; update it when
# route-to-text-tools: file-probing, in-place-edit, and read-only-git shell commands

column1: # warn-file-size (PostToolUse): oversized untracked source files warn; everything else is silent.
# The last two rows pin the secret-skip anchoring both implementations regressed on or must never
# regress on: a secret basename under a sample-named parent directory stays skipped (silent even
# though oversized), while the in-basename sample form is exempt from the skip and counted (warn).
# warn-writing-tells (PostToolUse): the written payload adds a banned character (em-dash, curly
# quote/apostrophe) and warns; clean text, exempt files, and tells only in the REPLACED text are
# silent. Payloads carry the characters as JSON \u escapes so this table stays ASCII.
# compact-test-output (PostToolUse): a passing run collapses to its summary, a run carrying failure
# indicators keeps every unrecognized line and drops only known noise, and anything the hook cannot
# positively classify passes through silently. The sixth field is the payload's tool_response.
